Harbor dredging resumes after storm delay

By R. Ames · October 14, 2026

Work to deepen the main channel restarted Monday, two weeks after a nor’easter pushed sand back into the cut.

“We lost about ten days,” said the harbormaster. The project is expected to finish in December.
